cleanParagraphs: The magic gourd suddenly pulled everyone into the Reverse Valley. Above them, the Snake Spirit began a spell, and the rocky exit quickly shrank. Big Brother rushed toward it, but the ground shook harder. Ms. Lin asked Summer to slow the team down. Summer noticed a broken stone bridge ahead and called Big Brother over.

Big Brother lifted the heavy bridge while Summer guided its loose end into place. Rolling stones fell down the slope, so Third Brother raised his strong body and blocked them. The others crossed the steady bridge safely. A bright red mark then appeared above Big Brother's hands. Grandpa pointed at its light, and everyone understood the valley's rule: a power worked only after it helped a companion.

Beyond the bridge, the path narrowed into a hot stone crack. Strong wind threw anyone who moved alone toward the walls. Second Brother studied the dust and found the hidden air vents. He called, "The wind is blowing harder near the left wall, but the middle path is safe." Fifth Brother saw small flames dancing across the hot stones.

Fifth Brother said, "I am cooling the stones now, so wait behind me." He poured water over the flames and cooled the narrow passage. Following Ms. Lin's plan, Summer divided everyone into two groups. Second Brother led the first group along the safe route, and Fifth Brother protected the second. When all of them crossed the crack, two new marks appeared together, and a stone doorway opened toward the valley's center.

At the valley's center, a tight net of thorns surrounded a high stone platform. Grandpa was trapped above it. When Big Brother stepped forward, the vines closed closer. Sixth Brother became invisible and slipped through a small opening. From inside, he called, "The thorns are tightening around Grandpa, so nobody should push the net." Then he threw a rope up to Grandpa.

Sixth Brother guided Grandpa toward the safe side and showed Fourth Brother where to aim. Fourth Brother said, "I am burning only the empty gap." After checking everyone's position, he burned a narrow opening through the thorns. Sixth Brother lowered Grandpa safely, and another two marks shone. Grandpa then recognized carved lines on the stone platform. The ancient pattern showed that all seven marks had to enter the exit in the order of the brothers' helpful acts.

Near the exit, the Snake Spirit chanted her spell backward. The last two marks flew toward the magic gourd, and anyone who grabbed them was thrown back. Seventh Brother raised the gourd, but he did not use it to capture anyone. He shouted, "The spell is pulling the marks toward us. We need to turn its force into help!" Third Brother stood in front of him.

Third Brother blocked the returning force while Big Brother held the mouth of the gourd steady. Seventh Brother said, "I am pointing the gourd toward that open crack now." He carefully turned it away from the team. Instead of swallowing his companions, the gourd sent the two marks through the opening and into their hands. The sixth and seventh marks glowed beside the others, and the team finally held the complete seven-color set.

The team carried all seven marks to the shrinking exit, but its colors kept changing places. Grandpa showed Summer the carved pattern. Summer lifted the marks and said, "The door follows each helpful act, not each brother's usual place." Ms. Lin added, "If everyone follows that order, the pattern will become complete." Summer said, "We gather here to remember whom each brother helped first."

Ms. Lin said, "The seven brothers will place their marks one by one." Summer checked each step and said, "The colors match now. We will return home together, and everyone will guide Grandpa through the gate." The last mark clicked into the exit, opening a seven-colored gate. They returned safely to the courtyard. Behind them, the Snake Spirit's spell broke apart, and the magic gourd became quiet.

mainIdea.text: When the magic gourd pulled Summer, Ms. Lin, Grandpa, and the seven brothers into the Reverse Valley, they learned that power could create a colored mark only after helping a companion. The brothers stopped rushing ahead and worked together: they steadied a bridge, found a safe route, blocked danger, controlled fire and water, and rescued Grandpa from the thorny platform. Seventh Brother then used the gourd to return the final marks instead of capturing anyone. Summer watched the team, Ms. Lin organized each step, and Grandpa explained the carved order. By placing all seven marks according to whom they had helped first, the brothers opened the shrinking gate, brought everyone safely home, and broke the Snake Spirit's spell.
